title: Why Calibrated BM25 Filtering Barely Reduced Context on LongMemEval
abstract: arXiv:2611.30500v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An assistant that summarizes old conversations may later need a detail from the original exchange. It can score archived passages against the question, but only passages that fit in the prompt reach the answering model. We tested whether a BM25 filter saves input tokens once that limit is taken into account. We calibrated the filter on passages that individually corrected an answer the model got wrong from the summaries alone. Across 75 LongMemEval questions, filtering changed one prompt and saved 0.096% of input tokens. With and without the filter, the model answered the same questions correctly under a second automated grading. On a random sample, two human graders' settled judgments agreed with the automated grades in 92.9% of definite comparisons (Cohen's kappa = 0.805). translated_title: 为什么经过校准的BM25过滤在LongMemEval上几乎没有减少上下文
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.30500v1 公告类型：新 摘要：一个负责总结旧对话的助手，之后可能需要原始对话中的某个细节。它可以对存档段落与问题进行相关性评分，但只有符合提示长度限制的段落才能送达回答模型。我们测试了在考虑这一限制的情况下，BM25过滤器是否能节省输入token。我们在那些能够单独纠正模型仅凭摘要作答时出错答案的段落上对过滤器进行了校准。在75个LongMemEval问题上，过滤只改变了一个提示，节省了0.096%的输入token。无论有无过滤器，模型在第二次自动评分下都正确回答了相同的问题。在随机抽取的样本上，两位人工评分员的最终判断与自动评分在92.9%的确定比较中一致（Cohen's kappa = 0.805）。基于早前区分“检索到的证据”与“实际送达的证据”的工作，我们为按固定顺序尝试完整段落的打包器提供了一个精确的测试。
tldr: 在LongMemEval的75个问题上，经过校准的BM25过滤仅改变了一个提示并只节省0.096%的输入token，且经人工评分验证（Cohen's kappa=0.805），表明在考虑提示长度限制后BM25过滤几乎无法减少实际送达的上下文。
en_tdlr: Calibrated BM25 filtering changed only one of 75 LongMemEval prompts and saved just 0.096% of input tokens, with human validation (Cohen's kappa = 0.805) showing that once prompt-length limits are accounted for, BM25 filtering barely reduces the context actually delivered to the answering model.
